scope: RGFCA and its immediate random-photo-first / six-species predecessor results that either narrowly missed a frozen gate, showed a nominal sensitivity, or left a prespecified diagnostic unresolved.
principles: No entry may rescue or reclassify its frozen primary decision.
No new threshold, bandwidth, variable decomposition, favourable seed, weighting rule, or subset may be selected because an observed p-value was close to a gate.
Unresolved analyses that were explicitly prespecified before the relevant outcome may still be completed.
Post-outcome follow-ups are limited to power/identifiability simulation, omnibus heterogeneity diagnostics, or genuinely new prospective questions.
A failed independent replication closes rather than strengthens the original near-miss explanation.

entries.near_miss_reason: Primary recurrence direction was positive and the p-value was near but above 0.05.
entries.supporting_directional_robustness: All prespecified scale/support sensitivity excesses and both Monte Carlo half excesses were positive; fine and coarse descriptive p-values were nominally below 0.05 but cannot rescue G1.
allowed_followup: complete still-unresolved preoutcome leave-one-realm-out and leave-one-major-family-out positive-excess stability gates
simulation of detection probability under partial recurrent architectures using the exact sampled geometry
simulation/bootstrap of consensus convergence as outer-realization count changes
forbidden_followup: new observed-data kernel bandwidth search
new observed-data grid search
new observed-data support threshold search
rerun with a different seed

entries.near_miss_reason: Only the 100-versus-200 running-consensus correlation missed the numerical convergence threshold among already completed running/half gates.
allowed_followup: bootstrap/synthetic convergence curve for 25/50/100/150/200 outer draws
estimate outer-realization count needed for median field correlation >=0.9 as a design recommendation for future experiments
forbidden_followup: extend the observed primary from 200 to more outer realizations and retroactively claim the old strong-stability gate passed

entries.near_miss_reason: Strongest parent environmental block and exactly on the Holm boundary, while the frozen decision rule required strictly p_Holm < 0.05.
allowed_followup: include thermal effects in an all-five-block species-level covariance/latent-heterogeneity diagnostic
estimate design minimum-detectable mean effect under the frozen five-block family
test thermal context only in a new prospective independent dataset/question
forbidden_followup: open BIO1/BIO4/BIO5/BIO6 variable decomposition for significance
change <= versus < rule
drop other blocks from Holm family

entries.near_miss_reason: Second strongest positive environmental parent block, with a nominal raw signal that did not survive the fixed family correction.
allowed_followup: include dryness/energy effects in the same all-five-block species-level covariance/latent-heterogeneity diagnostic
estimate design minimum-detectable mean effect under the frozen five-block family
new prospective independent mechanism test
forbidden_followup: open VPD/RSDS/GDD5/wind variable decomposition for significance
combine only thermal and dryness after observing their p-values and treat that as confirmatory

entries.near_miss_reason: Strongest nominal pairwise process interaction in the complete ten-pair family.
allowed_followup: include in all-ten-interaction species-level heterogeneity matrix
interaction-family power/MDE simulation
forbidden_followup: variable-level interaction decomposition
retest as a one-off family of one

entries.near_miss_reason: Second nominally small raw p-value in the complete ten-pair interaction family.
allowed_followup: include in all-ten-interaction species-level heterogeneity matrix
interaction-family power/MDE simulation
forbidden_followup: variable-level interaction decomposition
one-off retesting

entries.near_miss_reason: Looser three-cell sensitivities were nominally positive although the reliable five-cell primary was not.
allowed_followup: simulation of sparse-species bias and effective information
new prospective replication with fixed per-cell replication
forbidden_followup: reopen H4b
choose the three-cell threshold as the new primary

entries.near_miss_reason: Original exploratory moderator was directionally suggestive and some non-primary extent diagnostics were nominally positive.
allowed_followup: retain as an example in simulation of why nominal moderator patterns require replication
forbidden_followup: further observed-data rescue of the weakening-with-range explanation

entries.near_miss_reason: A strong sparse equal-species signal survived a stricter photo-level null but disappeared under information weighting and in the reliable frame.
allowed_followup: simulation of low-information equal-weight inflation
new prospective replicate with fixed minimum cell/photo information
forbidden_followup: promote the sparse sensitivity to the canonical result
further cutoff search on the same dataset

entries.near_miss_reason: Small-system shared-transition test was directionally suggestive but did not confirm a universal shared boundary.
allowed_followup: use as a benchmark scenario in power simulations of partial sharing
new independent systems
forbidden_followup: reinterpret as support

omnibus_postoutcome_diagnostics_authoriz.environmental_species_response_matrix: All five parent block species effects plus all ten pairwise interaction species effects; no outcome-based feature selection and no new confirmatory p-values.
omnibus_postoutcome_diagnostics_authoriz.simulation: Method/design detectability, missingness, partial-sharing, stability, and multiplicity simulations under a separately frozen contract.
omnibus_postoutcome_diagnostics_authoriz.prespecified_unresolved_stability: Leave-one-realm and leave-one-major-family G1 excess gates may be completed using outcome-independent taxonomy/realm metadata, without altering the primary result.
